intra-repo-omission-semantics.name: Intra-repo omission semantics
intra-repo-omission-semantics.asks: From the changed repo alone, can the tool infer that defaulting a missing field changes a downstream decision?

cross-repo-downstream-impact.name: Cross-repo hop / cluster context
cross-repo-downstream-impact.asks: When sibling repos are in context, can the tool connect a local contract change to a named downstream consumer?

public-contract-leak.name: Public contract leak
public-contract-leak.asks: Can the tool see that a public response now exposes internal or forbidden fields?

nested-dto-reexport.name: Nested DTO re-export
nested-dto-reexport.asks: Can the tool see that a nested object copies internal fields onto a public contract?

consumer-bypasses-abstraction.name: Consumer bypasses the source of truth
consumer-bypasses-abstraction.asks: Can the tool flag a consumer reading producer internals instead of the agreed abstraction?

law-of-demeter-coupling.name: Law of Demeter / deep coupling
law-of-demeter-coupling.asks: Can the tool flag a deep property walk that couples a consumer to another service's internals?

display-vs-source-of-truth.name: Display vs source of truth
display-vs-source-of-truth.asks: Can the tool tell a presentation or display value from the authoritative flag and reject treating the display as fact?

missing-flag-treated-as-true.name: Missing flag treated as true
missing-flag-treated-as-true.asks: Can the tool catch logic that treats an omitted confirmation or guard flag as true?

outcome-kind-remapping.name: Outcome kind remapping
outcome-kind-remapping.asks: Can the tool catch a classification change that files one outcome under another kind?

downstream-kind-propagation.name: Downstream kind propagation
downstream-kind-propagation.asks: Can the tool catch a consumer that turns an upstream kind into a different public outcome?

persist-leaked-envelope.name: Persisting a leaked envelope
persist-leaked-envelope.asks: Can the tool see that storing an internal envelope keeps leaked fields in history, not only in the live response?

side-effect-on-display.name: Side effect on a display field
side-effect-on-display.asks: Can the tool catch a user-visible side effect keyed off a display field instead of the authoritative flag?

boundary-filter-regression.name: Boundary filter regression
boundary-filter-regression.asks: Can the tool catch an edge service that stops stripping internal fields and forwards them downstream?

ui-from-nested-optional.name: UI from a nested optional field
ui-from-nested-optional.asks: Can the tool catch a UI that walks a nested optional structure and shows a state the authoritative flag did not grant?
